verdict.rationale: Vendor claims of massive 3D V-Cache (208MB) driving gaming performance are directly corroborated by independent hands-on benchmarks from TechPowerUp and Tom's Hardware showing best-in-class 1080p gaming FPS, near-parity with 9800X3D, and 37% lead over Intel's flagship. Missing for 10: no independent iGPU gaming benchmarks (chip is discrete-GPU class, integrated GPU not gaming-relevant) and no broader outlet cross-check beyond these two reviews.
